GLS.feature.theatre.title: Theatre
GLS.feature.theatre.hint: Theatre-of-the-mind scenes: a reel of full-screen shots (image or video) the GM cuts between with cinematic transitions and typographic title cards, so the table stays on one scene. Players' cameras are locked to the frame. Relights the Stage cast on every cut when Stage is enabled. System agnostic.
GLTH.settings.chatOnCut.name: Post a chat line on each cut
GLTH.settings.chatOnCut.hint: When the GM cuts to a shot that has a title, post its eyebrow, title and subtitle to chat as an out-of-character line, so the log records where the story went.
GLTH.settings.defaultStyle.name: Default transition for new Theatre scenes
GLTH.settings.defaultStyle.hint: The transition a newly created or converted Theatre scene starts with. Each scene can change it, and each shot can override it.
GLTH.settings.defaultFace.name: Default title typeface for new Theatre scenes
GLTH.settings.defaultFace.hint: The title typeface a newly created or converted Theatre scene starts with. Each scene can change it, and each shot can override it.
GLTH.style.centre.name: Centre
GLTH.style.centre.hint: Dip to black, then a centred title whose letter spacing collapses into place.
GLTH.style.chapter.name: Chapter
GLTH.style.chapter.hint: A push-in dissolve, with a chapter title wiped in at the lower left.
GLTH.style.credits.name: Credits
GLTH.style.credits.hint: Letterbox bars close and reopen on the new shot; the title types itself out in the lower bar.
GLTH.style.wipe.name: Wipe
GLTH.style.wipe.hint: A soft diagonal wipe, with the title rising word by word at the upper right.
GLTH.style.cut.name: Cut
GLTH.style.cut.hint: An instant swap to the new shot, then a centred title.
GLTH.style.interlude.name: Interlude
GLTH.style.interlude.hint: A text card over black. The image does not change underneath.
GLTH.cue.title: Re-announce title
GLTH.keys.nextHint: Cut to the next shot in the reel. Only on a Theatre scene; elsewhere the key does what it normally does.
GLTH.keys.prevHint: Cut back to the previous shot in the reel. Only on a Theatre scene.
GLTH.keys.reannounceHint: Play the title of the shot on screen again. Only on a Theatre scene.
GLTH.keys.blackHint: Cut the screen to black, or lift the black if it is already down. Only on a Theatre scene.
GLTH.scene.name: Name
GLTH.scene.convertBody: Turn "{name}" into a Theatre scene? It becomes a 3840×2160 gridless frame with token vision off, and its background image becomes the first shot. Leaving Theatre later puts the size, grid, vision and background back.
GLTH.scene.leaveBody: Switch Theatre off for "{name}"? Its original size, grid, vision and background are restored. The shots are kept, so converting it again brings the reel back.
GLTH.notify.left: "{name}" is no longer a Theatre scene.
GLTH.notify.sceneFailed: The Theatre scene change failed. See the console for details.
